_comment: position_offset values are in ArUco marker axis frame of reference

cups._comment: Sorting cups (red=0, green=1, blue=2). 25mm marker on side wall, 39mm cup outer radius, 96.5mm cup body height, marker centered at 45% of cup height, marker mesh inset 6mm into cup wall. The marker_to_object block declares the geometry; aruco_camera_localizer's marker_geometry module computes the offset = (X=0, Y=+0.00483, Z=-0.033) m at runtime. Y is POSITIVE here because ArUco PnP convention has marker local Y axis = UP on object (cup body center is above marker, so positive Y in marker frame). Verified against sim USD ground truth (cup_center - marker_center = -32.55mm in Y world, +4.83mm in Z world, 2026-04-25).
